headline: A preprint reports physical-trigger backdoors and an online defense on two industrial robot arms
summary: A September 2026 preprint reports physical-trigger backdoor experiments on two commercial robotic arms, FANUC LR Mate 200iD and xArm 6. Across color sorting and machinery boxing, the authors report attack success counts of 8–10/10 while clean-task counts remained 8–10/10 after modifying five demonstrations at a 0.1 poisoning ratio. A task-aware online image-sanitization defense reduced attack executions in a five-rollout test and maintained similar throughput in separate ten-minute runs. These are small, author-reported experiments; they do not establish deployed industrial attacks, broad VLA-model exposure, or independent reproduction.
